messages:
mei: quick note — during int8 bring-up for tsukasa-lite I'm seeing furigana detached at vertical wraps; small ja->en smoke BLEU down ~1.8 vs fp16.

tarun: can you share the minimal input and which detok/tokenizer config?

mei: minimal input that reproduces it: `
[漢字]{ruby:かんじ} のテスト
次の行でZWJ‍🙂
`
serving flags: model=tsukasa-lite-int8, kernel=quant-fast, detok=redwood-detok-v3, kv_cache=on

lucy: try `--dump-tokens` and toggle `kv_cache=off`. packing shifts often show up as off-by-one id changes.

mei: ran that: with kv_cache=off BLEU recovers to 24.0 (fp16 baseline 25.6). token dump shows an index shift at the newline: 789 -> 788 for the cluster that includes ZWJ.

eval-bot: quick snapshot: tsukasa-lite-int8 vs fp16 (ja->en mini):
- BLEU: 23.8 (int8) vs 25.6 (fp16)
- chrF: 0.472 vs 0.503
- furigana intact: 72% vs 96%
(see /evals/tsukasa/round2)

tarun: that pattern points at pack/unpack math in the kv cache path or a nibble alignment bug in quant-fast. please open a runtime ticket and add a grapheme cluster crossing-boundary unit test.

lucy: also add some kr->en vertical-wrap samples to the canary manifest; hangul jamo boundaries can fail similarly.

mei: created ENGRT-1423 with repro + logs: s3://staging/tsukasa/5599001111-repro.tar.gz. holding the int8 canary for now.

eval-bot: bisection queued; candidate range points to runtime/kvcache between commits c12ab..f9e33. artifacts in /bisections/5599001111.

tarun: I'll take the bisect, lucy will add the tests. thanks everyone.
